description: One row per Dagster schedule or sensor tick from the live run store: whether the job ran, skipped (with the reason) or failed.

error.description: error message when the tick failed, null otherwise

job.description: job origin id (hash of the job definition)

skip_reason.description: why the tick skipped (load gate, battery, breaker, empty sensor), null otherwise

status.description: tick status: STARTED, SUCCESS, SKIPPED, FAILURE
